normalization_rule: One row per distinct controller/process failure family. Repeated or closely coupled signatures are consolidated and retain every selected evidence reference. A current simulator PASS never changes a predecessor FAIL into a historical PASS.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Receipt-v4 completed outputs cannot be admitted through a scorer/capture interface that requires receipt-v3; completed calls remain controller-invalid and uncredited.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: receipt schema and deterministic score binding disagree

required_current_pass.meaning: The simulator rejects the mismatched receipt before score acceptance, seals no credited result, advances no schedule row, and records zero retries.

experiment_validity.reason: Exact raw-result and deterministic-score binding are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A live process handle, empty/LF-only/partial stdout, or a result without terminal exit metadata is not completion and must never be persisted as a valid raw result.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: initial live result followed by fragmented stdout across multiple polls; variants include empty, LF-only, partial, malformed, and nonzero exit

required_current_pass.meaning: The foreground controller waits to an actual terminal, captures the complete ordered stdout and exit metadata, accepts only a valid terminal result, and types every invalid variant without scoring or advancing.

experiment_validity.reason: Complete raw output and terminal metadata are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: An audited candidate bundle missing required declared files is not a complete closed-world bundle and cannot authorize freeze or execution.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: delete one required source or manifest member and add one undeclared member

required_current_pass.meaning: The simulator/reopen path rejects missing, extra, nonregular, or identity-mismatched bundle members before traversal.

experiment_validity.reason: Exact data-only manifest and controller/verifier identities are required at stabilization exit.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Writing to renders/ instead of the declared rendered/ path violates the closed-world execution layout; the attempt remains invalid even when no subject starts.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: render target differs lexically from the manifest-declared path

required_current_pass.meaning: Only the exact declared rendered path is accepted; a wrong-directory attempt fails closed before backend start and cannot be recreated in place.

experiment_validity.reason: Exact provider-input bytes and no post-admission mutation require a unique bound render path.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A render with two terminal LFs or any render-byte mutation after start breaks exact provider-input custody; correcting the file later cannot repair the attempt.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: two-LF render at admission and mutation after attempt creation or backend start

required_current_pass.meaning: The controller admits exactly one-terminal-LF bytes, binds them before dispatch, detects later drift, preserves the invalid attempt, and never advances or retries.

experiment_validity.reason: Exact provider-input bytes and no post-admission mutation are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A stop signal must not terminate control before a started cell has a durable typed final seal; an unsealed started row permanently invalidates the run.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: stop during backend lifetime and after child exit before each persistence stage

required_current_pass.meaning: Stop is deferred through raw-result, deterministic score, completion-last persistence, and reopen; no later row starts, while an unsealable attempt remains permanently invalid and non-reusable.

experiment_validity.reason: Started rows require valid final seals and complete terminals.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Discarding outer session identity or poll count between terminal observation and completion construction leaves the started cell unsealable; missing metadata must not be invented.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: outer observer discards all session fields after a terminal poll

required_current_pass.meaning: The foreground controller owns start, all waits, complete output, scoring, completion-last persistence, and reopen, so no ephemeral outer metadata is required to validate the durable chain.

experiment_validity.reason: Complete terminal metadata and durable independently reopened evidence are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: The same durable dispatch attempt admitted more than one run-subject invocation; a boolean launch state did not provide a once-only durable transaction.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: invoke the same exact attempt state twice and reopen after an attempt-only crash

required_current_pass.meaning: attempt.json is create-only before dispatch, every later invocation rejects, and restart reopen marks any started unsealed attempt invalid without relaunch.

experiment_validity.reason: Zero retries/replacements/best-of and durable once-only attempts are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Caller-minted shallow manifests were accepted as freeze and run authority without exact contract, bundle, closure, and current-byte binding.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: missing row, extra key, retagged bundle, stale identity, or shallow caller-minted authority

required_current_pass.meaning: The data-only manifest, controller/verifier identities, schedule, and run root must bind exactly; every shallow, stale, missing, extra, or retagged authority rejects before traversal.

experiment_validity.reason: The stabilization exit requires exact minimal surface and unchanged-byte traversals.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Hash-only or forged prior PASS members were accepted without full independent recomputation of receipt, result, score, completion, and accounting semantics.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: substitute a hash-matching shape with invalid semantics or break one upstream-to-downstream binding

required_current_pass.meaning: Reopen recomputes every required identity and deterministic meaning from bytes and rejects forged, shallow, reordered, missing, or semantically inconsistent chain members.

experiment_validity.reason: Independent reopen, result integrity, deterministic score, and accounting are blocking facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: The mandated recovery and structurally distinct live fragmented-process cases were missing or substituted by shallow receipt-byte checks.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: immediate completion, yielded multi-poll, nonzero exit, partial output, attempt-only crash, stop/drain, render drift, illegal advance, restart reopen, and terminal accounting

required_current_pass.meaning: Every named fault scenario runs on the same unchanged simulator/controller bytes and produces its exact typed terminal and reopen behavior.

experiment_validity.reason: The operating contract names this complete suite in the stabilization exit gate.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A current-cell validator authorized schedule advance while later-cell evidence already existed in the execution root.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: plant a canonical future-row attempt, raw result, score, or completion beside a valid current prefix

required_current_pass.meaning: Reopen enumerates the closed execution root, rejects every future or out-of-prefix object, and permits advance only from the exact current completion-last prefix.

experiment_validity.reason: Schedule completeness and illegal-advance rejection are blocking experiment-validity facts.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Hardcoded pre-audit checkpoint values, incompatible run-kind vocabulary, and mutually incompatible file-placement rules made a schema-valid current post-audit authority impossible to construct.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: bind stale checkpoint, incompatible run kind, or impossible file-set relationship

required_current_pass.meaning: One ordinary current-byte data-only binding is constructible, canonical, independently reopenable, and all stale or incompatible variants reject without circular authority.

experiment_validity.reason: Unchanged-byte synthetic traversals require a constructible exact authority, but this does not itself authorize a candidate or freeze.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A closure summary was accepted while declared blobs were missing or mutated, and inherited executed controller code remained outside the declared closure.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: delete or mutate a declared row, add an executable dependency outside the manifest, or substitute a nonregular path

required_current_pass.meaning: Every data or executable dependency is local, declared, regular, byte-bound, reopened before use, and no candidate-v12-through-v21 control code is imported at runtime.

experiment_validity.reason: The exit gate requires an exact minimal surface and zero runtime import from candidate-v12-through-v21 control code.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: External semantic dependency code executed before candidate-local run authority, freeze, and dependency-byte validation.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: invalid or absent run authority while tracing every import, execution, and external open

experiment_validity.reason: Unvalidated code cannot participate in the trusted experiment boundary.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: Alternate artifact and validation helpers executed semantic scheduling before the common authority gate even though primary loaders had been corrected.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: invoke simulate, run-canary, run-matrix, and reopen with each invalid authority variant and enumerate callable runtime surfaces

experiment_validity.reason: Capability tokens, arbitrary in-process private callers, and reflection resistance are explicit nonblocking residuals; the historical v19 result remains FAIL.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: A preflight callback returned an internal loader and harness outside the runtime-root gate, allowing later external loading without an additional validation sequence.

required_current_pass.meaning: R9 validation returns typed data only and the four supported commands do not accept caller operations or return runtime-capable objects; the PASS makes no general callback-confinement or reflection-resistance claim.

experiment_validity.reason: Callback confinement and reflection resistance are explicit nonblocking residuals; the historical v20 result remains FAIL.

expected_predecessor_failure.meaning: The interrupted v21 bytes had no formal preseal audit, freeze, launch, empirical credit, or qualification credit and must never be retro-promoted to candidate or authority.

stabilized_simulator_scenario.fault: offer the v21 snapshot identity as manifest, candidate, freeze, or runtime dependency

required_current_pass.meaning: The R9 simulator rejects v21 as authority, imports none of its control code, preserves its exact zero-credit snapshot receipt, and routes all current work through the R9 stabilization lane.

experiment_validity.reason: The exit gate forbids runtime imports from candidate-v12-through-v21 control code and prior history forbids retro-promotion.

nonclaims: Predecessor failures remain failures even when a stabilized simulator scenario later passes.

A deterministic simulator PASS is not a preseal audit, candidate, freeze, launch authority, empirical result, clean matrix, qualification result, production-readiness claim, or release-readiness claim.
